decisions.reason: Distinct conjugated derivatives survive a closed coarse T^48 loop; translation equivalence cannot identify them.
Exact coarse triple restored; zero and target permutations agree with the pinned output; all four sources fixed.
Alternate spanning tree, all20736 existing edges and separately replayed merger loops give exactly the same3+6 partition.
At most r!*(4!)^2 for zero/source/target IDs only; sectors or other extra data need their own bound.
At most four actual source-image choices on this connected component. Regular root, actual cover point and preserved complete source fiber are essential.
Transported reflection ceases to be Euclidean; explicit full marked square-torus control after shear is not an orthogonal-room unfolding.

required_qualifications: Connected component and regular source root; image is an actual point of the cover, not only its torus projection.
The factorial bound covers only the named zero/source/target IDs, not separately named zero sectors or full reflection derivatives.
The3+6 transport partition is certificate-specific; disagreement edge counts depend on spanning tree.
Half-turn uniqueness gives an upper bound; extension, label preservation and order two must still be checked.
